text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you understand.
zh: 我们用简易英语进行真实对话，帮助你理解。
zh_hant: 我們用簡易英語進行真實對話，幫助你理解。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can watch a video of this podcast
zh: 你可以观看本播客的视频，
zh_hant: 你可以觀看本播客的影片，

text: and find a worksheet to help you learn on our website,
zh: 并在我们的网站上找到帮助学习的练习册，
zh_hant: 並在我們的網站上找到幫助學習的練習冊，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you today?
I'm very good, Neil.
How are you?
I'm very well.
What are we talking about?
Today we are talking about work and the office .
zh: 今天我们聊工作和办公室。
zh_hant: 今天我們聊工作和辦公室。

text: An office is a place with desks and computers
zh: 办公室是有桌子和电脑的地方，
zh_hant: 辦公室是有桌子和電腦的地方，

text: where people do their jobs.
OK.
We are in a studio in the office ,
zh: 我们现在在办公室的演播室里，
zh_hant: 我們現在在辦公室的演播室裡，

text: but we'll go back to the office after this.
zh: 但之后我们会回办公室。
zh_hant: 但之後我們會回辦公室。

text: Yes we will.
So, Neil, where do you work?
zh: 那么，尼尔，你在哪里工作？
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你在哪裡工作？

text: Do you work at home or do you work in the office ?
zh: 你在家工作还是在办公室工作？
zh_hant: 你在家工作還是在辦公室工作？

text: Well, I do both of those things.
I work in the office usually three days a week,
zh: 我通常每周在办公室工作三天，
zh_hant: 我通常每週在辦公室工作三天，

text: and I work from home two days a week.
OK, I'm the same.
We have the same schedule.
So, yeah, at home twice,
where I have, a sort of place that could be considered a home office .
zh: 在那里，我有一个可以算作家庭办公室的地方。
zh_hant: 在那裡，我有一個可以算作家庭辦公室的地方。

text: Do you like working in the office ?
zh: 你喜欢在办公室工作吗？
zh_hant: 你喜歡在辦公室工作嗎？

text: I do like working in the office .
zh: 我确实喜欢在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 我確實喜歡在辦公室工作。

text: I think it's easy to get work done in the office
zh: 我觉得在办公室容易完成工作，
zh_hant: 我覺得在辦公室容易完成工作，

text: because it's an office environment.
It's a workplace.
But I also quite like working from home sometimes because, commuting.
zh: 但我有时也挺喜欢在家工作的，因为通勤。
zh_hant: 但我有時也挺喜歡在家工作的，因為通勤。

text: London is a big city,
you know, coming to work and going back is really tiring
zh: 你知道，每天上下班真的很累，
zh_hant: 你知道，每天上下班真的很累，

text: if you do it every day.
Yeah, I know what you mean.
I like working from home occasionally,
but I definitely prefer being in the office .
zh: 但我绝对更喜欢在办公室。
zh_hant: 但我絕對更喜歡在辦公室。

text: I think being with colleagues around you and I need people,
zh: 我觉得身边有同事，我需要人，
zh_hant: 我覺得身邊有同事，我需要人，

text: and then I can work better.
Yeah.
So what's wrong with working from home ?
zh: 那在家工作有什么不好？
zh_hant: 那在家工作有什麼不好？

text: A lot!
I think, when you're in the office ,
yeah, it's louder than at home,
but I like having the people around me.
I like being able to have conversations.
I find it's easier to work in an office environment
zh: 我发现办公室环境里更容易工作，
zh_hant: 我發現辦公室環境裡更容易工作，

text: because everyone else is working.
But I feel more lonely at home because it's just me.
zh: 但在家我感到更孤独，因为只有我一个人。
zh_hant: 但在家我感到更孤獨，因為只有我一個人。

text: So, yeah.
I understand what you mean.
I also have a bit of a problem with working from home ,
zh: 我在家工作也有点问题，
zh_hant: 我在家工作也有點問題，

text: because the boundary or the line between work and home is not so clear.
zh: 因为工作与家庭之间的界限或分界线并不那么清晰。
zh_hant: 因為工作與家庭之間的界限或分界線並不那麼清晰。

text: So when you finish your day,
zh: 所以当你结束一天工作时，
zh_hant: 所以當你結束一天工作時，

text: you close your computer and you think,
oh, hang on, I'm still at home.
This is where I've been working all day.
zh: 这就是我整天工作的地方。
zh_hant: 這就是我整天工作的地方。

text: And sometimes you feel like you should be doing things for home
zh: 有时候你会觉得在真正工作时
zh_hant: 有時候你會覺得在真正工作時

text: when you're actually working.
Yeah, it's a bit weirder .
Like, it's, it's strange being at home because it's harder to know
zh: 就像，在家感觉很奇怪，因为更难知道
zh_hant: 就像，在家感覺很奇怪，因為更難知道

text: whether you should be working or doing a bit of housework.
zh: 应该工作还是做点家务。
zh_hant: 應該工作還是做點家務。

text: In the office , it's easier to just sit and be with your laptop,
zh: 在办公室，更容易坐下来对着笔记本电脑，
zh_hant: 在辦公室，更容易坐下來對著膝上型電腦，

text: be with your colleagues and just be, be working.
zh: 和同事们在一起，就是工作。
zh_hant: 和同事們在一起，就是工作。

text: Have you ever worked somewhere that is not an office ?
zh: 你曾在办公室以外的地方工作过吗？
zh_hant: 你曾在辦公室以外的地方工作過嗎？

text: Yes.
So I used to work at a farm.
It was a farm park.
So lots of children playing and there was a cafe.
zh: 有很多孩子在玩，还有一个咖啡馆。
zh_hant: 有很多孩子在玩，還有一個咖啡館。

text: There was a play area, go carts, being with animals.
zh: 有游乐区、卡丁车，还有动物。
zh_hant: 有遊樂區、卡丁車，還有動物。

text: So lots of different areas.
And it was fun.
Lots of variety.
So that wasn't an office .
zh: 所以那不是一个办公室。
zh_hant: 所以那不是一個辦公室。

text: What about you?
I've worked in all kinds of places, especially when I was a student.
zh: 我在各种地方工作过，尤其是当学生的时候。
zh_hant: 我在各種地方工作過，尤其是當學生的時候。

text: I worked in factories, farms.
I've worked in restaurants, bars, all kinds of places that are not offices .
zh: 我在餐馆、酒吧工作过，各种非办公室的地方。
zh_hant: 我在餐館、酒吧工作過，各種非辦公室的地方。

text: You've done it all.
I've done it all.
Let's recap some of the vocabulary we heard in this podcast.
zh: 让我们回顾一下本播客中学到的一些词汇。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下本播客中學到的一些詞彙。

text: We had office ,
a place with desks and computers where people go to work sometimes.
zh: 一个有桌子和电脑的地方，人们有时去那里工作。
zh_hant: 一個有桌子和電腦的地方，人們有時去那裡工作。

text: At BBC Learning English, we work in the office.
zh: 在BBC英语学习，我们在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 在BBC英語學習，我們在辦公室工作。

text: We had working remotely ,
which we often also call working from home ,
zh: 我们经常也称之为“在家工作”，
zh_hant: 我們經常也稱之為“在家工作”，

text: and that means working somewhere that isn't the office, for example, your home.
zh: 意思是在非办公室的地方工作，比如你家。
zh_hant: 意思是在非辦公室的地方工作，比如你家。

text: But it could also be a cafe or something.
zh: 但也可以是咖啡馆之类的地方。
zh_hant: 但也可以是咖啡館之類的地方。

text: And we also had colleagues .
These are the people that you work with.
zh: 这些是和你一起工作的人。
zh_hant: 這些是和你一起工作的人。

text: And we compared working from home with working from an office.
zh: 我们比较了在家工作和在办公室工作。
zh_hant: 我們比較了在家工作和在辦公室工作。

text: And we used lots of comparatives.
So it's harder to concentrate at home or it's more difficult to get your work done in the office.
zh: 所以在家里更难集中注意力，或者办公室里更难完成工作。
zh_hant: 所以在家裡更難集中注意力，或者辦公室裡更難完成工作。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《简易英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《簡易英語》就到這裡。

text: You can test what you've learned with a worksheet,
zh: 你可以用练习册测试所学内容，
zh_hant: 你可以用練習冊測試所學內容，

text: which you can download for free from our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 可以从我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com免费下载。
zh_hant: 可以從我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com免費下載。

text: And next time we'll be talking all about games.
See you then.
Goodbye.
